World Coffee Forum 2026 · Theme

Why We Drink Coffee?

Asia’s Premier Coffee Knowledge & Insight Platform.

World Coffee Forum is Asia's leading coffee knowledge and insight platform, where coffee professionals, brands, creators, and everyone who loves coffee learn together, share inspiration, and discover new perspectives.

Your story as a world champion offers the most compelling answer to why we make and drink coffee.

Join us on the stage of World Coffee Forum 2026, and help create a moment where new inspiration blossoms across the coffee scene in Asia and around the world.

Champion Live

Global Leaders of the Coffee Industry,
on the World Champions' Stage.

Champion Live is the flagship program of World Coffee Forum, where world coffee champions share their skills, experience, and philosophy on coffee. Beyond a simple demonstration, it offers participants fresh inspiration and insight by sharing the experience and know-how accumulated on the world stage directly with industry professionals.

Program Format

Beyond the Competition,
Share Your Experience.

Champion Live is a participatory program combining live demonstrations, talks, and Q&A with the audience. Participants can meet the champion's expertise and experience, philosophy on coffee, and brand story in person, and engage in in-depth conversation.

1

Program FormatLive Demonstration + Presentation + Q&A

The session combines a live demonstration and talk with Q&A from participants.

2

Interactive Experience

Participants can experience the champion's performance up close, ask questions directly, and engage in conversation.

3

Speaker Opportunity

Introduce your skills, philosophy, and story about coffee to global coffee industry professionals and future coffee people.

4

Full Operational Support

The World Coffee Forum secretariat supports the overall event operations so speakers can focus on their content.
